title: George T NDE 3594
content: When I had my NDE experience, I was at home as I had just taken some pills. I tried to kill myself. Although it appeared to me like a dream but in fact, everything was real. I saw next to me two sturdy men who took me in their arms in order to transport me to the ambulance; they looked very tall and very bright. Afterwards I found out that I had been walking to the ambulance on the arm of this nurse who helped me. I was told that I had been lying at the back of the ambulance all the way to the hospital - but I remember being in front, next to the driver, I even felt the breeze on my face. At the same time, I could not understand why he did not answer me. After some time we arrived at the hospital, and I saw everything they did in order to resuscitate me. At the same time, I went down the hallway to speak with this man who was covered in blood and was trying to get up from the floor. I helped him and I asked him what had happened to him? He told me he overdosed in order to take his own life, but now he couldn't move and no one was helping him. I think once in a while, I was back in my body for a second or so and I could see everything around me but did not understand. This is a short description of what happened to me during my first NDE. P.S. Since that day I dream about people who had been deceased and about future events, some of them apocalyptic, in some cases I know when people are going to die, weeks in advance, it is simply horrible to have that kind of knowledge.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: In the ambulance he recalls being 'in front, next to the driver' rather than in the back; later he observed resuscitation efforts at the hospital and also went down a hallway to speak with another man.

arrival.other_being_detail: He saw 'two sturdy men' who were 'very tall and very bright' and who took him in their arms to transport him to the ambulance.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He reports intermittently being 'back in my body for a second or so' during the event.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Overdose: 'I had just taken some pills. I tried to kill myself.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed ambulance transport and hospital resuscitation; interacted with a blood-covered man in a hallway who said he had overdosed.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE perceptions included ambulance ride (front seat), observation of resuscitation, and moving down a hallway to speak with another person; he also describes brief intermittent returns to the body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Intermittently 'back in my body for a second or so.'
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He reports simultaneously seeing resuscitation efforts while also going down the hallway to speak with the blood-covered man.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reports interacting with a blood-covered man in the hospital hallway who said he overdosed to take his own life and that no one was helping him.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Although it appeared to me like a dream but in fact, everything was real.”; “I remember being in front, next to the driver, I even felt the breeze on my face.”; “Since that day I dream about people who had been deceased and about future events… in some cases I know when people are going to die, weeks in advance.”
